title: Autonomous Road Sweeper
summary: An autonomous cleaning system for complex road environments.
challenge: Deliver safe, continuous cleaning in dynamic road environments.
approach: Combine perception, task decisions, and vehicle control into a deployable autonomous workflow.

title: Autonomous Bipedal Locomotion
summary: Perception and locomotion research for bipedal robots in unstructured environments.
challenge: Balance stable locomotion and task adaptation in complex environments.
approach: Co-design environmental perception and motion control for closed-loop operation in physical settings.

title: Marine Autonomous Navigation
summary: Autonomous perception, localization, and navigation for waterborne systems.
challenge: Handle environmental changes and navigation uncertainty in open-water settings.
approach: Combine scene perception, state estimation, and path decisions for autonomous waterborne operation.
